title: Work Done by a Force
summary: W = F × s: when a force does work, when it does none, and negative work by friction.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines

objectives: I can calculate work done using W = F × s.
I can explain why some forces do no work.
I can relate work done to energy transferred.
misconceptions: Any effort, like holding something heavy, is work in physics.
